checks.name: T038 trace endpoints and SADS promotion challenged
checks.command_or_evidence: independent resolution of every T038-L-* refines/allocated_to/decomposes_to/implemented_by/verified_by/analyzed_by/validates edge; cross-check of the requirement-record parents and unit-record source_paths against the refines/implemented_by links; REF-002 register/reference inspection
checks.measured: every trace endpoint resolves: each requirement/component/unit/scenario source and every non-code target is a declared inventory artifact, each implemented_by target is an existing file, each verified_by target is a declared measure (unit/integration/validation) and each analyzed_by target is static_analysis, and every refines target is a declared register requirement. No allocated or deferred SADS requirement is promoted (20 ids, 10 allocated / 10 deferred, all architectural-target, empty promoted). Three record-metadata divergences from the authoritative links.json were found and are recorded as non-blocking observations (OBS-1, OBS-2, OBS-4): they do not create an invalid or missing trace edge under the accepted schema and no endpoint fails to resolve.

observations: OBS-1 (non-blocking record/link convention divergence). engineering/requirements/T038-STK-002.json:9 declares parents=[XCOM-SYS-SC-009] (matching the requirements.md:256 spec-anchor row), but the materialized trace adds refines edges T038-L-0003 -> XCOM-SYS-FR-030 and T038-L-0004 -> XCOM-SYS-FR-029 (engineering/trace/links.json:22860,22868) and links no edge to XCOM-SYS-SC-009; T038-STK-001 similarly gains an undeclared refines edge T038-L-0002 -> XCOM-SYS-FR-029 (links.json:22852) beyond its declared parent XCOM-SYS-FR-030 (T038-STK-001.json:9). The chain still resolves to declared register requirements, so this is a record/link documentation-convention divergence rather than a missing or stale endpoint (the T036 internal-review IRV/OBS-1 precedent for a requirements.md spec-anchor column citing a different anchor than the materialized trace); recommend the deferred external review (T039/T040) reconcile the stakeholder-record parents with the refines anchors, or confirm the convention explicitly.

OBS-2 (non-blocking record/link convention divergence). engineering/unit-specifications/T038-SR-001-U.json:27-29 lists source_paths [docs/engineering/xcom/t038/verification-plan.md, engineering/trace/links.json] while its implemented_by links target docs/engineering/xcom/t038/requirements.md and docs/engineering/xcom/t038/verification-plan.md; T038-SR-007-U.json:30-32 lists [engineering/project.json, engineering/trace/links.json] while its implemented_by links target engineering/project.json and docs/engineering/xcom/t038/requirements.md. The T035/T036/T037 unit records have zero such divergence, so this is a plan-stage metadata sloppiness unique to T038; the implemented_by endpoints still exist and resolve.

OBS-3 (non-blocking evidence-snapshot completeness). The report evidence.scanned_files records 47 files, while the verifier now scans 49 retained files; the difference is docs/engineering/xcom/t038/implementation.md (written 31 s after the report at the implementation stage) and reports/xcom-queue/t038-traceability.json itself. The live scan is clean and the substantive public-safety property holds, but the verifier does not validate evidence.scanned_files against its own live scan set, so the recorded list can silently drift. Recommend the successor reconcile the recorded scan list or validate it.

OBS-4 (non-blocking verifier blind spot). check_chain's stakeholder-refines check accepts any target starting with 'XCOM-SYS-' that is a declared register id and does not require the refines target set to equal the requirement record's parents; this is why the OBS-1 divergence passes. Strengthening the verifier to compare refines targets against the record parents (or documenting the convention) would close the blind spot.

OBS-5 (intentional acyclic binding). docs/engineering/xcom/t038/implementation.md and docs/engineering/xcom/t038/internal-review.json are deliberately excluded from the report candidate_identity.material_inputs and hashes so the report can cite its own digest without a circular binding (T036/T037 precedent); the 54 material inputs cover every machine-checked artifact.

OBS-6 (no promotion). All twenty REF-002 communication ids retain their accepted disposition (10 allocated / 10 deferred, all architectural-target); the capability disposition is 'unchanged' and the promoted list is empty. No allocated or deferred SADS target is promoted by this candidate.
